summary: Hand-built near/locker/vacancy commands over coinlocker-navi HTML, the Maihama live map and the Multi Ekicube ph2 JSON, with source-dated output and explicit unknowns.
reason: The internal-yaml spec only mirrors raw HTML/JSON pages (source search|locker|ekicube). The domain adapter parses them, joins live data by coordinates or locker id, derives gate side only from Multi Ekicube structured fields, and paces requests at about 1 per second per host. near.go replaces the generated novel scaffold; README and SKILL template text that assumed a SQLite store was rewritten. root.go Short/Long and the MCP server name used the title-cased slug (Coinlocker Navi) instead of the research display_name (Coin Locker Navi). The generated HTML source commands defaulted to Accept: application/json, which this site answers with HTTP 500; they now send an HTML Accept header and carry Examples and kebab-case happy-args.
validated_outcome: go test ./... passes (fixtures + httptest); shipcheck 7/7 PASS; live probes for near --live, --open-during and --gate pass.
